name: SuiteIQ
pitch: Every luxury hotel and cruise, every date, one screen. Then book through your advisor for the perks.
blurb: SuiteIQ reads the public booking feeds of Four Seasons, Waldorf Astoria, Conrad and LXR for 13 months of nightly rates and every room type, plus eleven cruise lines from Seabourn to Virgin Voyages with per-person fares by sailing. Filter by state, brand, month, length or price, tap two calendar days to total a stay, and send a quote request to a Preferred Partner or Virtuoso advisor with everything filled in.
features: 67 US luxury hotels with 13 months of lowest nightly rates and 1,500+ room types
6,500+ cruise sailings across 11 lines, weekend getaways included
Quote requests that name the advisor amenities: breakfast, credits, upgrades, Virtuoso Voyages
Live filter counts so a number never promises more than the list shows
privacy: Rates are read from the hotels' and cruise lines' own public booking sites. Your name, email and advisor list stay on your device.

name: ReadIQ: Article Reader
pitch: Paste a link, read it clean. Any article, reader mode, saved for later, read aloud.
blurb: ReadIQ opens the page in a real browser, keeps only the article, and shows the text with your typography. Save articles to read offline, listen with the device voice, and share from Safari straight into the app. When a site refuses a server, the app reads it on your iPhone with your own logins.
features: Reader mode for any page, with size, serif or sans, and light, sepia or dark themes
Listen mode, tap a paragraph to jump
privacy: Articles you save stay in the app. Nothing is sent anywhere except to the site you asked to read.

name: CutIQ
pitch: A design studio for your Silhouette cutter, iPad first, with an AI copilot.
blurb: Draw, type, size and weld designs on a 12 by 12 or 12 by 24 mat, in inches or millimetres, then export true-size SVG, DXF or PNG for Silhouette Studio. Twelve bundled fonts plus runtime font install, image tracing, offset and weld, layers and undo.
features: DXF export that Silhouette Studio imports for free
Text to real cut paths in 12 fonts, install more at runtime
Trace a photo into a cuttable shape
AI copilot that drives the canvas with plain language

name: WideIQ
pitch: Vertical video, widescreen result. On your iPhone, no upload.
blurb: Turn a portrait clip into a real landscape video in 1080p or 4K, with blur fill or crop fill, then save it to Photos or share it anywhere.
features: No account, no server, no subscription
